Message:
I left the mountain
just as yuh willed me to, but...
what could I do
to appease yer anger...?

Just what is my duty
supposed to be, anyway...?
Please tell me,
Great Dragon God~...!

Haah...! The person
leavin’ that mansion
has horns on their head...

Don’t tell me
the Great Dragon God
has appeared before me
in answer to my prayers...!

“Great Dragon God...!
What is my duty, anyway?!

But, yuh’ve got the same
beautiful set o’ horns as
the Great Dragon God does...!”

“If yuh aren’t
the Great Dragon God,
then who are yuh?
...‘Cu Sith’...?”

With a troubled
look on ’er face,
Miss Cu Sith said,
“People are staring,
so could you stop
crying like that?”
I then hurried
an’ looked around us.

A bunch o’ strangers
were starin’ at us,
their eyes as wide as saucers...

Or rather, they were starin’ at me,
who was bawlin’ my eyes out
in Miss Cu Sith’s arms...

Waaah! This is the most
embarrassin’ moment of my life...!
